title: 第2章 体质12点！常人极限！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此刻讲台上的老师也将目光看向了众人：“看来你们已经成功转职了自己想要的职业，现在，如果有人获得了词条，注意这第一个自由属性点，最好是加在契合词条的属性上！”

“老师，我获得了【强壮】词条！”一个身材魁梧的青年满脸惊喜地站了起来。

“很好！”老师满意地点了点头：“有了【强壮】词条的你，现在的你其他人相比，直接多出了一个普通人的生命力！”

“明天早上前往试炼世界，你拥有词条，老师会为你介绍一些人，你跟着他们进入试炼世界就好了。”

魁梧青年满脸激动地点了点头，旋即坐了下来。

“强壮词条？”看着青年激动无比的样子，罗兰瞥了一眼自己的基因锁词条，默默不语。

“好了，现在你们使用自由属性点。”

众人有些骚动，随即便平静了下来，因为此刻每个人都在按照自己的规划，将1级获得的自由属性点给使用掉！

此刻罗兰凝视数据面板，精神仿佛化为了无形的手指，狠狠点击在了加点按钮上！

“给我加点！”

【体质属性提升！11→12】

【你当前体质属性为12点！】

一瞬间，罗兰便感觉到自己体内一股力量瞬间爆发了出来，随后这种力量眨眼间便融入到了他的身体之中。

这种感觉来得快去的也快，仿佛是错觉。

不过罗兰此刻却十分清楚，他的体质属性，已经到了12点！

“现在我的体质，已经到了蓝星没有坠入虚界之前的人体极限水平！”

罗兰深深吸了一口气，感受着自己此刻身体的变化！

此刻，罗兰只觉得自己心脏每一次跳动，都变得比以前更加有力！更加缓慢！

他的呼吸，不知不觉将变得悠长，肺部变得更加健康，能容纳更多的氧气！

每一次呼吸，都仿佛是在吐故纳新！

虽然没有测试，但是罗兰知道，自己现在无论是耐力还是对疾病的抵抗力，都大幅度的增强了！

现在的他，哪怕和一群患有流感的人呆在一起，也不会轻易感冒！

此刻，已经抵达人体极限水平的体质，让罗兰只觉得自己仿佛脱胎换骨了一样！

“这种体质，甚至让我的大脑都清明了不少！”

At this moment, the teacher on the podium also looked at everyone: "It seems that you have successfully transferred to the career you want. Now, if someone obtains an entry, pay attention to this first free attribute point. It is best to add it to attributes that match the entry!"

"Teacher, I got the [Strong] entry!" A burly young man stood up with surprise on his face.

"Very good!" The teacher nodded with satisfaction: "With the [Strong] entry, you now have the vitality of an ordinary person compared to others!"

"Go to the trial world tomorrow morning. You have the entries. The teacher will introduce you to some people. You just need to follow them into the trial world."

The burly young man nodded excitedly and sat down immediately.

"Strength entry?" Seeing the young man's extremely excited look, Roland glanced at his gene lock entry and remained silent.

"Okay, now you use free attribute points."

Everyone was a little commotion, but then calmed down, because at this moment everyone was using the free attribute points obtained at level 1 according to their own plans!

At this moment, Roland stared at the data panel, and his spirit seemed to turn into invisible fingers, and he clicked on the add point button!

"Give me more!"

[Physical attributes improved!11→12]

[Your current physical attribute is 12 points!】

In an instant, Roland felt a power burst out from his body, and then this power integrated into his body in the blink of an eye.

This feeling came and went quickly, as if it was an illusion.

However, Roland knew very well at this moment that his physical attributes had reached 12 o'clock!

"Now my physique has reached the limit of the human body before Blue Star fell into the virtual world!"

Roland took a deep breath and felt the changes in his body at this moment!

At this moment, Roland felt that every time his heart beat, it became stronger than before!More slowly!

His breathing will become longer before he knows it, and his lungs will become healthier and can hold more oxygen!

Every breath seems to be exhaling the old and absorbing the new!

Although there is no test, Roland knows that both his endurance and resistance to diseases have been greatly enhanced!

Now, even if he stays with a group of people who have the flu, he will not catch a cold easily!

At this moment, Roland's physique had reached the extreme level of the human body, making Roland feel as if he had been reborn!

"This kind of physique even makes my brain a lot clearer!"
